what_this_is: The registry of affiliate programs PetTripFinder may route a booking action through (PTF-MEASUREMENT-001 Phase 1b). A provider listed here is NOT a program the site is enrolled in: enrolled is false until the business holds an approved program, and a per-market affiliate_destinations.json row that names an unenrolled provider fails the build. A destination_url may only point at a host in its provider's allowed_destination_hosts. No provider is enrolled; no destination exists.
